about: Recorded from the iPhone's Swift before the move (Browser.select, refreshIfStale, didCommit's modsLoaded, the modsstale step): which tabs load again when the mods change. shown: a tab shown → start (its first load) or refresh (looked at). loaded: the signature a page keeps as it commits (a change not in the scripts yet: "pending", so it counts as stale). stale: the kept signature against the one for its address now (null: not loaded). refresh: later (scripts not in yet: once they are), keep, ask (whether it plays, then recheck) or next (recheck without asking: Pause all). recheck: playing (not loaded again now), keep or reload.
